basis: Defined by intellectual disability; additional syndromic organ involvement is unspecified.
Malignant tumour arising in lung and pleura; aggressive behaviour does not establish common damage to other organs.
Skeletal malformations and intellectual disability define the syndrome. Genital hypoplasia alone does not establish endocrine dysfunction; strabismus frequency is unknown.
Multiple cutaneous cylindromas define this skin tumour syndrome; subcutaneous nodules occur in 80-99%.
Congenital myopathy with contractures; cardiomyopathy in 8/8. Speech and motor delay may reflect muscle weakness; independent CNS damage is insufficiently established.
Substance-induced psychotic disorder; no specific neurological tissue injury or other axis disease is established.
Vitelliform lesions and dystrophy directly affect the macula, even when visual impairment is absent or mild.
Congenital skeletal muscle disease. Feeding weakness and infantile apnea do not establish separate gastrointestinal or pulmonary damage; cardiac defects occur in 1/8.
Intellectual disability, seizures and distal limb anomalies define the syndrome; hearing impairment occurs in 30-79%. Feeding difficulty alone does not establish GI damage.
Impaired bile flow affects the liver or intrahepatic/extrahepatic bile ducts, all within the hepatic axis.
BH4-related amino acid and neurotransmitter disorder; direct neurological dysfunction and neurodevelopmental delay occur in 30-79%, sometimes despite phenylalanine control.
Ear, CNS and cardiac malformations define embryopathy; cleft palate occurs in 30-79%. Nail hypoplasia (30-79%) omitted under the four-axis cap.
Partial PAH deficiency defines this metabolic disorder. Common lasting neurological injury is not established for this mild subtype; elevated phenylalanine alone is insufficient.
Structural displacement of a vertebra; neurological compression is not an obligatory or established common component.
Inflammation of lymphatic vessels, classified as vasculitis and usually infectious. Overlying red streaks do not establish separate skin damage.
Early posterior polar lens opacity defines the disease; the broader CRYAB spectrum does not establish myopathy or cardiomyopathy in this cataract subtype.
Hereditary colorectal cancer syndrome. Associated extracolonic cancers are separate diseases and predisposition risks, not involved organs.
Trigeminal nerve dysfunction defines the disorder. Vascular compression does not establish vascular damage; feeding difficulty and ocular pain do not establish organ injury.
Philophthalmus eye-fluke infection occupies and inflames the conjunctival tissues.
Neoplasm involving the pineal body, an intracranial endocrine gland; both brain and endocrine sites are explicitly represented in its ancestry.
Lysosomal storage disorder; skeletal/joint disease, corneal clouding and valvular disease each affect >30% over the course. Organ enlargement alone does not establish liver injury.
Asthma defines immune-mediated airway disease. Short stature alone does not establish skeletal or endocrine damage; elevated IgA alone does not establish immunodeficiency.
Malignant astrocytic tumour arising in the CNS; tumour microvascular proliferation does not constitute a separate cardiovascular disorder.
Infection directly inflames and damages brain tissue; no additional organ involvement is common across this umbrella.
Premature ovarian insufficiency is loss of gonadal endocrine function; amenorrhea and infertility are accompanying reproductive manifestations.
